ease.$description:
── Motion ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Content is ALWAYS visible by default; motion is enhancement layered on
top, never the thing that makes content appear. brignano.io shipped a
homepage whose contact CTA was invisible on 100% of loads because an
animation library owned the visible state. See DESIGN.md §7.
